#### What this PR does / why we need it:

This PR implements `--keep-git-dir` flag for `ADD` https://docs.docker.com/reference/dockerfile/#add---keep-git-dir, as described in option 1 in this triage https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/issues/7043#issuecomment-5409170031.

#### How to verify it

I will write tests and polish the code once if it is decided that this is the right approach.

```release-note
`ADD` from git souces no longer includes the `.git` directory by default. Either  `--keep-git-dir` or `--keep-git-dir=true` is required to include it.
```

comments.body: Is this a reasonable approach to move towards docker compatibility, given that it implies a breaking change for users who expect the `.git` to be there without the flag?
